name: Patrick Criado
bio: Patrick Criado was born on September 23, 1995 in Madrid, Madrid, Spain. He is an actor, known for Mar de plástico (2015), El aspirante (2015) and El Rey (2014).

credits.title: Karateka

credits.title: 1898: Our Last Men in the Philippines
credits.overview: The Philippines, 1898. Fifty Spanish soldiers arrive in the small village of Baler to rebuild an outpost. They will be the last to surrender.
